Landing.heroSubtitle: Manage your business efficiently with BillForge. Generate invoices, track your Khata, manage products, and keep your customers happy—all in one place.
Landing.previewNote: Illustrative workflow. Your workspace will show your own records after you sign in.

Landing.previewKhataTitle: Keep customer dues in one ledger

Landing.featuresTitle: Billing tools for everyday Indian business work
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Start with invoices, customers, products and Khata. BillForge keeps the work in one focused workspace without promising more than the app provides.
Landing.invoiceFeatureTitle: Build itemized invoices with the details you need
Landing.invoiceFeatureBody: Add customer details, products, tax rates and HSN or SKU information, then review the result before printing.
Landing.invoiceFeatureStatusBody: Check the totals and invoice details in the preview.
Landing.khataFeatureTitle: Keep track of Udhaar without a paper register
Landing.khataFeatureBody: Record credit sales, partial payments and advances, and keep the customer balance history together.
Landing.recordsFeatureTitle: Keep customers, products and billing activity together
Landing.recordsFeatureBody: Use one workspace for the customer directory, product catalog, invoice history and Khata activity you choose to record.
Landing.languageFeatureBody: Switch between the available languages and choose a light or dark theme that suits your working day.
Landing.reportsFeatureTitle: See summaries based on your own records
Landing.reportsFeatureBody: Review sales, invoice counts and receivables after you add records to your workspace.
Landing.workflowTitle: Set up the work you do every day
Landing.workflowInvoiceBody: Add customers and products, calculate the bill and print the invoice when it is ready.

Help.title: Run your business with confidence.
Help.subtitle: Short, practical answers for the workflows that matter: billing, GST fields, Khata, records, and Copilot privacy.
Help.supportDescription: If a workflow does not behave as expected, send us the screen, the action you took, and the reference shown in the error state. Never send passwords or API keys.
Help.gettingStartedBody: Complete your business profile first, then add products and customers before creating your first invoice.
Help.gettingStartedOne: Add the legal/business details you want printed on invoices.
Help.gettingStartedTwo: Create products with a price, GST rate, stock quantity, and optional SKU/HSN.
Help.gettingStartedThree: Create or select a customer, then review every invoice before saving it.
Help.invoicesBody: BillForge separates invoice creation from the final review so customer, GST, stock, and payment details can be checked before saving.
Help.invoicesOne: Cash, UPI, and other paid modes are recorded as invoice payments; Khata is used for credit sales tied to a customer.
Help.invoicesTwo: The server recalculates product prices, GST, stock, and totals before an invoice is persisted.
Help.invoicesThree: Cancelled invoices remain part of the audit history and are excluded from active totals.
Help.khataBody: A positive balance means the customer owes the business. A negative balance means the customer has an advance or credit.
Help.khataOne: Record credit sales as a sale entry and collections as a payment entry. Cancelling a paid credit sale leaves the received amount as customer credit unless you settle it separately.
Help.khataTwo: Use the customer statement to see the transaction timeline and running balance.
Help.khataThree: A Khata reset archives related active invoices, cancels active entries, and records the reset for audit; it does not delete the customer or product catalog.
Help.gstBody: GST treatment is calculated from the business and customer state relationship plus the product GST rate.
Help.gstOne: Same-state invoices use CGST and SGST; inter-state invoices use IGST.
Help.gstTwo: Product prices and GST rates are rechecked on the server; the review screen is the place to catch an unexpected total.
Help.gstThree: Add HSN or SKU values to products when your business workflow needs them on records or printouts.
Help.copilotBody: Copilot is a read-only assistant. It reads a bounded, tenant-scoped summary when you ask a question and cannot create, edit, cancel, or delete records.
Help.copilotOne: The context includes a 30-day aggregate plus limited recent invoice, receivable, low-stock, and product-sales rows.
Help.copilotTwo: An answer is not a replacement for opening the source invoice, customer ledger, or product record.
Help.copilotThree: If the provider or database is unavailable, BillForge shows an error instead of estimating a number.
Help.privacyBody: Keep your workspace credentials private. Use the visible error state and reference when reporting a problem.
Help.privacyOne: A tenant-scoped workspace backup is available in Settings. Account deletion is not a self-service action yet.
Help.privacyTwo: If a save request times out, refresh the relevant list before submitting again to avoid duplicate actions.
Help.privacyThree: For destructive actions, read the impact summary and keep the confirmation phrase exact.
